rationale: The agent only updated the version string in package.json and ran yarn install, but did not adapt the source code to the breaking API changes in @actions/github v5. The verifier shows that the tests fail because the code still uses the old v4 API (e.g., `octokit.repos.listReleases` instead of `octokit.rest.repos.listReleases`), leading to runtime TypeErrors. The reference patch confirms that the source code in `src/index.ts` requires specific API surface updates to match the new dependency.
